Problem Description

Troubleshooting
:
As we received case from you regarding Mainfan_GQ1 Ok Signal Lost - Fan rotation disabled false, have to carry out following activities for troubleshooting:
1. Check the voltage between L3 and N3, Voltage should be around 230 v.
2. Check for the voltage between 24v1,.3 and Ground, Voltage should be around
3. Check for the loose wiring of the XD7 connector. If it is found to be loose or broken have to be replaced. You check for the spare part at
Sicharge D - Spare Parts Cat. C (sharepoint.com)
4. Check for the continuity from the DI9 pin of KF5 to the 6th Pin of Fan.
For future reference, your case number is
0421155
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Mohini Patil
